name: kick-contest
description: #99 (balance/plans/kick-contest.md): bombs a real contest, grubbers that race into the in-goal, scrambles you can read. Between even sides: about 1 bomb in 5 contested (won back 6–10%, spilled 10–14%), 0.2–0.4 grubber tries a match, and tries, points, completion and penalties inside §7. A Kick-chase side (both ways) shows the chase pays more often; a rating gap checks the stronger side still wins about 70%. Run on main for the before and on the branch for the after. No coach calls.
